title: ADN Energía S. de R.L. de C.V. (also referred to as ADN Energía or ADN Energia)
description: ADN Energía is a Mexican company specializing in the commercialization and logistics of solid fuels and petroleum coke. It markets over 1 million tons per year of petroleum coke (high, medium, and low sulfur), along with metallurgical coke, anthracites, and coal mixtures. The company serves industries including cement, lime, steel, and mining-metallurgy, and provides specialized transportation and cargo services across Mexico.  It began operations in 2004 (originally as García Munté Energía de México) and is based in San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León.*once the timer expires, the files will be available for sale — submit your request to the operator https://www.adnenergia.com
